answer_2.quote: For topic quality, we consider two metrics: Topic Coherence (TC) and Topic Diversity (TD). Topic Coherence assesses how coherent the identified topics are by examining the co-occurrences of the top words with an external corpus. We adopt a widely-used coherence metric C V , which has shown superior performance compared to other coherence metrics . Specifically, we compute C V with Wikipedia texts as a reference corpus using Palmetto library . Furthermore, Topic Diversity measures how distinct the topics are by calculating the proportion of unique top words across the topics.
